name: The Hotel Mortimer
tagline: A Halloween séance at the grand hotel where no guest ever checks out.
description: Every Halloween the Hotel Mortimer holds a séance in its ballroom to greet the bride who vanished from Room 13 in 1901. Gilt mirrors, flickering chandeliers, a medium in black lace and thirteen minutes of total darkness. Tonight, when the lights came back on, the hotel's owner was gone. A gothic Halloween mystery.
artStyle: Gothic 1920s art deco horror, a grand hotel lobby lit by guttering candles, gilt mirrors, green gaslight, sepia photographs

cocktails.name: The Vanishing Bride
cocktails.recipe: Gin, elderflower liqueur and lemon, shaken and topped with sparkling wine.
cocktails.mocktail: Elderflower cordial, lemon and sparkling white grape juice.
